en.title: Oloop — Social media on autopilot
en.desc: A free, open-source Chrome extension. Add media and text once; Oloop opens X, Threads, Instagram, RedNote, TikTok, YouTube, Bilibili, Pinterest, note and Naver Blog side by side, in the browser you are already signed into.
